question: What access does this user have to this record, as the platform calculates it?

steps.name: u
steps.soql: SELECT Id FROM User WHERE Username = '{user}'

steps.name: access
steps.soql: SELECT RecordId, HasReadAccess, HasEditAccess, HasDeleteAccess, HasTransferAccess, MaxAccessLevel FROM UserRecordAccess WHERE UserId = {@u.Id} AND RecordId = '{record}'

traps: This is the sharing answer only. Field access is separate (access.field-grants).
